items.briefing:
A new survey finds IT professionals consider password sharing the top security lapse in their organisations — a reminder that sharing login credentials, even with trusted colleagues, creates real risk. Separately, Australian organisations using AI tools should be aware that new research from OneTrust highlights significant gaps in AI governance locally, as adoption outpaces policy and oversight frameworks.

Cisco has released a patch for a critical vulnerability in its Secure Email Gateway product that is actively being exploited. If your organisation uses this product, ensure your IT team applies the update promptly.

**Practical tip:** Never share your work passwords with colleagues — if someone needs access, ask IT to set up their own account.
